jobs.occupation: C++ Software Engineer for LLRF Feedback Control for PETRA IV (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

C++ Software Engineer for LLRF Feedback Control for PETRA IV

Limited: 2 years | Start: 01.11.2026 | ID: MMA050/2026 | Deadline: 22.09.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The MSK group manages beam feedback, radiofrequency control, specialised diagnostics, and synchronisation systems for DESY's accelerators. We are an international team of technicians, engineers, and scientists who develop, install, and operate complex devices, and embedded systems for the EuXFEL, FLASH, PETRA III, and the upcoming PETRA IV storage ring.

With the PETRA IV project, DESY is launching one of the most ambitious and innovative large-scale research projects worldwide. PETRA IV, the most brilliant synchrotron radiation source of the next generation, will be the ultimate 4D X-ray microscope, setting new standards in precision and performance. To implement the project, we are looking for motivated employees who want to get involved in a complex project with international appeal. More information about PETRA IV: PETRA IV (https://desy.de/microsites/petra-4/content/index_eng.html)

About your role:

- Development of software concepts and software architecture, including exception handling for the LLRF feedback systems of the PETRA IV project
- Review of software requirements, design, and functionalities for the PETRA IV project
- Software development and support for LLRF feedback test stands
- Integration of C++ control application into large-scale accelerator control systems
- Maintenance, refurbishment, and upgrades of control software for the PETRA III accelerator

About you:

- MSc or PhD degree in computer science, electrical engineering or similar discipline
- Excellent knowledge and professional experience in modern C++ (17/20/23)
- Good knowledge on hardware interfaces and hardware programming based on FPGAs and SoCs
- Professional experience in software development for particle accelerators or storage rings
- Professional experience in middleware of large-scale control systems such as TANGO, EPICS or DOOCS
- Good knowledge in compiling software specifications and requirements
- Self-directed with a strong focus on high-quality work
- Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team
- Fluent in spoken and written English

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Martin Killenberg at +49 40 8998-3011, martin.killenberg@desy.de

jobs.occupation: ERP Integration Lead (all genders) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role:

As the ERP Integration Lead for the our Life Science business, you will lead the governance, design, and continuous evolution of the application integration landscape supporting our global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. Working closely with Business Process and IT Solution Owners, the ERP Design and Build organization, the Deployment Leads, Integrated Enterprise Solutions as well as our implementation partners, you will drive the delivery of scalable, standardized, secure, and compliant integrations between SAP S/4HANA and connected business applications. You will provide technical leadership throughout the integration lifecycle from architecture and solution design through implementation, deployment readiness, and cutover support. Your leadership will ensure a robust and resilient integration landscape that enables successful global deployments while preserving enterprise architecture principles and clean core standards.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end ERP Integration function within the global SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
- Own the governance, quality, and continuous evolution of the application integration landscape supporting the global ERP template.
- Define and govern enterprise integration principles, interface standards, API strategies, middleware architecture, and integration patterns across SAP and connected business applications.
- Govern technical integration decisions and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, clean core strategy, and global technology standards.
- Provide leadership and governance for the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of application integrations across functional workstreams and implementation partners.
- Ensure integration consistency and technical solution integrity across multiple concurrent deployment programs while balancing global standardization with justified local requirements.
- Partner closely with Deployment Leads to enable technical deployment readiness, interface validation, cutover planning, technical issue resolution, and successful deployment execution.
- Collaborate with ERP Design and Build, Data Migration, Testing, Validation, Security, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Manufacturing, and other technology teams to deliver an integrated enterprise solution.
- Ensure application integrations are designed, built, tested, and delivered in compliance with validation requirements, and global quality standards by partnering closely with Validation organizations to support deployments into regulated environments.
- Drive planning and governance for integration readiness, interface testing, technical defect resolution, deployment preparation, and cutover activities across all integrated applications.
- Identify technical risks, interface dependencies, and architectural constraints early and proactively manage mitigation plans to support successful program delivery.
- Provide leadership and direction to internal teams, external implementation partners, SAP, and technology vendors while driving accountability, delivery excellence, and effective collaboration.
- Leverage SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform, APIs, event driven architecture, and emerging SAP technologies to continuously improve the enterprise integration landscape and accelerate future deployments.

Who You Are:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- 10 or more years of experience leading SAP integration, enterprise application integration, or large scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
- Extensive experience designing and governing enterprise application integration landscapes supporting SAP and non SAP business applications.
- Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA technical architecture, SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform, APIs, middleware technologies, and modern enterprise integration patterns.
- Proven leadership experience managing global technical teams and implementation partners across multiple concurrent initiatives.
- Strong knowledge of enterprise integration governance, enterprise architecture, clean core principles, cybersecurity, and SAP implementation methodologies.
- Demonstrated experience leading integration solution delivery in GxP regulated Life Science, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or similarly regulated industries is highly desirable.
- Deep understanding of deployment readiness, integration testing, interface validation, technical cutover planning, and transition from build to deployment.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business and IT leaders across global organizations.
- Outstanding communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value.
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to balance technology strategy, business value, operational stability, risk, and delivery timelines.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross functional teams without direct authority in a matrix organization.
- Experience leading multiple concurrent initiatives within a global ERP transformation program.
- Fluent in English. German or another European language is considered an advantage.

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in Germany.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

You'll lead a team of four responsible for day-to-day client support, build the processes and product expertise that are shared across the team, and shape a more proactive way of working with clients.This is not a role where you inherit a finished machine. You'll inherit a strong product, demanding expert users, a good team, and a function that needs clear ownership, deep product expertise, strong tooling, and a proactive way of working. Working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering, you'll help define what a modern, efficient Customer Success function looks like for our market.This is a hands-on builder role for someone comfortable with ambiguity, who enjoys getting close to the product and the client as much as leading a team.

• Own the quality of day-to-day client support, making sure questions are answered quickly, clearly, and to a consistently high standard.
• Own support escalation, ensuring complex, urgent, or sensitive cases move through the organisation in a structured way instead of bouncing between people.

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Technical Data Management, Airbus is looking for a

Solution Architect - Technical Data Management (d/f/m)

We are seeking a highly skilled Solution Architect for Technical Data Management (TDM) to design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure TDM solutions within Airbus Commercial. In this role, you will balance technological opportunities with business requirements, serving as System Architect for Agile Release Train OneTDM while ensuring consistency across IT products and alignment with Enterprise Architecture guidelines.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days paid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead the design and architecture of TDM solutions and related systems, acting as System Architect for Agile Release Train OneTDM.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and development teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
- Secure the integration of solutions across applications, systems, and platforms while ensuring alignment with Enterprise Architecture guidelines.
- Evaluate and select appropriate technologies, tools, and platforms for TDM solutions, managing associated technical risks.
- Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams, developing key architectural documentation and defining data governance policies.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
- Proven experience (15+ years) as an IT Architect, with a strong focus on Technical Data Management solutions in a large-scale enterprise environment.
- In-depth knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and TechnicalData Management (TDM) systems (Dassault Systèmes VPM V4 and Catia V5).
- Strong expertise in data modeling, database design, data integration patterns, enterprise integration technologies (ESB, APIs), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Scientist for the development of the German EOSC‑Node

Limited: 2 years | Start: earliest possible | ID: FHMA022/2026 | Deadline: 03.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The DESY Information Technology (IT) division participates in a wide range of high-profile national and European projects, evaluating and developing innovative IT technologies. One of its key activities is the establishment of the German EOSC Node in collaboration with ten leading research institutions across Germany as part of the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI). This initiative requires close coordination across more than 300 German universities and research institutions, as well as with national and European research infrastructures.
To support this ambitious endeavour, we are seeking a scientist with expertise in modern web technologies, particularly the development of user-facing web portals and backend services. The successful candidate will be motivated to contribute to the design, development, and operation of these technologies within the evolving European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) ecosystem.

About your role:

- You will contribute to the overall architecture and the design of the German NFDI EOSC Node
- You will coordinate the selection and methodology for developing a service portfolio compatible with existing requirements for the EOSC Node
- You will enhance and deploy a portal for accessing Web Services for the EOSC Node
- You will ensure that the representation of service records is harmonized and aligned with interoperability specifications in the EOSC
- You will participate in regular project meetings, workshops and conferences, both online and in person, and you will contribute to regular reports towards the project management

About you:

- You have completed a master's degree in computer science, physics or related subjects
- You have good knowledge of Web Technologies and at least one modern programming language
- Familiarity with modern cloud technologies, such as CI/CD and Kubernetes, is beneficial
- Experience with user-facing web portals, REST APIs and/or backend development is a plus
- You have good spoken and written command of the English Ianguage
- You are a collaborative team player who enjoys working in large, international teams
- You are open to travel

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work-life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

Master student in the field of Acoustics - Interior Noise (d/f/m)

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.01.2027

We are offering a Master Thesis opportunity focusing on acoustics, specifically interior noise. This role provides a unique chance to contribute to cutting-edge aerospace research and development within a leading global company.

* Extensive technical expertise and very good knowledge of

jobs.description:

- Conduct complex route analyses , including the assessment of decompression and OEI scenarios as well as aircraft performance
- Analyze and evaluate aircraft performance data
- Monitor published aircraft performance information and work closely with our internal Efficiency Team in the area of Airplane Performance Monitoring (APM)
- Develop and optimize aircraft performance applications
- Actively contribute to the further development and optimization of processes and applications within Flight Operations
- Prepare Operational Risk Evaluations (OREs) and contribute to the safe and reliable execution of our operational processes
- Work closely with a variety of internal and external stakeholders

Ihr Profil:

What you bring:

- A completed university degree, ideally in aerospace engineering , or a comparable qualification combined with relevant professional experience
- Several years of relevant professional experience in aviation engineering , Aircraft Performance or a comparable technical environment
- Strong analytical and conceptual skills
- A strong understanding of economic and operational interrelationships
- Initiative and the ability to drive topics forward independently and take ownership
- Confident communication style as well as strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills
- Flexibility and willingness to familiarize yourself with new technical and specialist topics
- Very good German and English language skills , both written and spoken

jobs.occupation: Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft Offshore-Windkraftanlagen (m/f/d) (Techniker/in - Windenergietechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
Imagine a future where you play a key role in ensuring electrical safety across our offshore substations and wind turbines while helping us push the boundaries of safe, efficient, and reliable offshore operations.

Join us in this role where you’ll take independent ownership of electrical safety within your area of responsibility, overseeing electrical installations on wind turbines in our German wind farms. You’ll combine your deep technical expertise with on-site presence—both at your permanent base in Norddeich and offshore—in order to guide colleagues, strengthen procedures, and ensure safe systems of work.

Welcome to HV and Transmission GER

You’ll be part of HV and Transmission GER, where you and your colleagues will ensure electrical safety governance and operational support across high-voltage infrastructure in our German offshore wind farms. Your team is dedicated to managing safety-critical systems, uplifting operational standards, and sharing expertise across the organisation.

As a team, we collaborate closely, support one another’s development, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.

You’ll play an important role in:

- preparing and reviewing risk assessments for offshore electrical work
- supporting the selection, training, and supervision of Authorised Persons, electricians, and electrically instructed persons offshore
- contributing to the qualification and supervision of contractors in the offshore electrical environment
- developing, implementing, and improving maintenance plans for offshore electrical installations
- coordinating multiple employers involved in offshore electrical activities
- planning, organising, delivering, and documenting electrical safety training
- implementing, strengthening, and regularly reviewing the Wind Turbine Safety Rules (WTSR) and Orsted Electrical Safety Rules (OESR)
- assuming designated roles within the Safe Systems of Work, such as Authorising Engineer, Authorising Officer, or Training Mentor
- auditing work processes before offshore deployment.

To succeed in the role, you:

- have completed a degree within electrical engineering, or equivalent
- bring strong expertise within electrical safety, including standards, laws, and regulations
- demonstrate technical leadership competence
- offer switching experience in high-voltage environments above 20 kV
- communicate confidently in both English and German at B2 level or higher
- are comfortable using IT systems, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AI tools
- ideally have a qualification for live working, experience with wind turbines, or prior responsibility as an electrician
- meet the minimum competency requirements within your onboarding timeframe, supported by our learning and development processes.

**Country-specific requirements: **fulfil the requirements of a responsible electrician (vEFK) according to VDE 1000-10.

Please note that in this role you will be mainly working in our office in Norddeich from Monday to Friday. An important part of the role will be an inspection of plants and the professional guidance of the electricians. This requires partial work offshore (20-40%) in a 7- or 14-day shift pattern.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us
Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.
